answer: Use a beacon-slotted identity lottery. Each epoch, a randomness beacon releases a capped number of new-identity slots, far below demand. Like a prism splitting light, the pool is divided into distinct, non-transferable positions. An applicant claims one with a unique signed voucher — a sonnet, one per key, unreusable and non-transferable — plus a small burn fee. A sybil attacker cannot mint identities at will: each fake identity must win a scarce slot in an open lottery, so attack cost scales linearly with identity count and batch creation gets no discount.
